name: Addressable loop powered Open Area Beacon Red Lens with Isolator IP65

subcategory.name: Analogue Addressable Audio Visual & Voice Alarms

family: Loop Powered Addressable Sounders, Beacons And SounderBeacons
summary: The Intelligent Addressable Open-Area Visual Indicator Beacon of Context Plus has been developed for use in situations where there is a risk that sounders will not be heard. It is powered directly from the loop and need no external power supply.
description: The Context Plus Addressable panel will be able to drive up to twenty five 55000-009 beacons per loop on average. However, the maximum number of devices that may be connected to a particular loop should be determined by a loop loading calculation.
features: Operates at 17–28V DC and is polarity sensitive.
Comes with Isolating Base as standard
